phases.name: Adaptation
phases.description: Get comfortable on the bike with short, easy rides
phases.coachNote: RPE 2-3: very easy spinning. Focus on smooth pedaling and getting used to saddle time. Indoor or outdoor both fine.

phases.name: Building
phases.description: Extend ride duration and introduce gentle effort variations
phases.coachNote: RPE 3-4: breathing deepens but you can still talk. Try slight variations in effort - a short hill or a few faster spins.

phases.name: Consolidation
phases.description: Ride longer and stronger with confidence
phases.coachNote: By week 8, aim for 45-60 min continuous riding. You're ready for weekend exploration rides!

Tue.name: Easy Spin 20min RPE 2-3
Tue.coachNote: Flat route. Focus on smooth pedal strokes.

Thu.name: Easy Spin 25min RPE 2-3
Thu.coachNote: Keep the legs spinning lightly. No grinding.

Sat.name: Easy Ride 30min RPE 2-3
Sat.coachNote: Enjoy the weekend ride. Explore a new route!

Tue.name: Endurance 30min RPE 3-4
Tue.coachNote: Add a slight hill or headwind section. Keep it manageable.

Sat.name: Endurance 40min RPE 3-4
Sat.coachNote: Longer weekend ride. Pack water and enjoy!

Tue.name: Endurance 35min RPE 4
Tue.coachNote: Steady effort throughout. Find your rhythm.

Thu.name: Easy Spin 30min RPE 2-3
Thu.coachNote: Active recovery. Keep legs spinning light.

Sat.name: Long Ride 50min RPE 3-4
Sat.coachNote: You're a cyclist now! Enjoy the journey.

trainingPlan.name: 8-Week Beginner Cycle
trainingPlan.description: A gentle introduction to cycling, building from 20-minute rides to 50-minute continuous riding.
trainingPlan.goal: Build cycling endurance to ride 45-60 minutes comfortably
